type.provenance: On and after January 1, 2025, no person shall sell, offer for sale, distribute for sale, or distribute for use in the State any product in any of the following product categories if the product contains an intentionally added PFAS chemical:

who.provenance: no person shall sell, offer for sale, distribute for sale, or distribute for use in the State

action.provenance: no person shall sell, offer for sale, distribute for sale, or distribute for use in the State

products.provenance: any product in any of the following product categories

value: A drug, medical device, biologic, or diagnostic approved or authorized by the United States Food and Drug Administration or the United States Department of Agriculture
Veterinary pesticide products approved by the United States Environmental Protection Agency for use in animals
A material used in the packaging of the materials described in paragraphs (1) and (2)
A product sold or resold before the effective date of this amendatory Act of the 103rd General Assembly
exceptions.provenance: 'Product' does not include any of the following:

type.provenance: On and after January 1, 2025, a PFAS manufacturer of cookware sold in this State that contains an intentionally added PFAS chemical in the handle of the cookware or in any surface of the cookware that comes into contact with food, foodstuffs, or beverages shall list the presence of PFAS chemicals on the cookware's product label

who.provenance: a PFAS manufacturer of cookware sold in this State

action.provenance: a PFAS manufacturer of cookware sold in this State

value: The surface area of the cookware is not large enough for a product label that meets the requirements of subsection (f) to be affixed to the item

The cookware does not have any of the following: (A) An exterior container or wrapper upon which a product label can appear or be affixed, (B) A tag or label to which information about the cookware may be attached
exceptions.provenance: Cookware is exempt from this Section if it meets all of the following requirements:

type.provenance: A PFAS manufacturer that sells or distributes a product that contains intentionally added PFAS chemicals for use in the State shall submit a written notification to the Agency

date.provenance: A PFAS manufacturer who sells or distributes a product containing intentionally added PFAS chemicals for use in the State on or before December 31, 2024 shall submit the written notification required under this subsection no later than 30 days before January 1, 2025

who.provenance: A PFAS manufacturer that sells or distributes a product that contains intentionally added PFAS chemicals for use in the State

action.provenance: A PFAS manufacturer that sells or distributes a product that contains intentionally added PFAS chemicals for use in the State

value: Products containing intentionally added PFAS chemicals
products.provenance: a product that contains intentionally added PFAS chemicals for use in the State
